cond_0001.intro: The Supplier Quality Engineer is responsible for qualifying and maintaining suppliers according to [Company name masked] standards. Ensures that suppliers deliver quality parts, materials and services consistently. Work with sourcing, purchasing, quality, manufacturing and engineering to assist in the resolution of supplier related issues. Performs supplier audits to ensure compliance with quality standards. Evaluates supplier's internal functions to assess their overall performance and provides feedback to all departments involved. Develops and maintains the internal supplier rating and reporting system.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Responsible for assuring supplier compliance to purchase order requirements
Evaluate quality systems and process controls of potential new suppliers
Review and approve supplier PPAPs
Improve supplier performance and productivity
Develop/revise procedures for supplier control
Update and maintain a supplier development program
Maintain the Approved Supplier List
Plan and conduct audits at suppliers and subcontractors
Must have or complete ISO 9001:2015 / IATF 16949:2016 Lead Internal Auditor certification within 12 months
Perform validation of supplier corrective actions
Interface with plant personnel, suppliers and buyers on a daily basis
Work with suppliers and subcontractors to develop and maintain ISO 9001:2015 / IATF 16949:2016 compliant quality systems
Responsible for the disposition of any potential discrepant supplier material
Travel – must be willing to travel up to 25%
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering
Minimum of five years related experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience working with suppliers along with a proven track record of reducing incoming material defects
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of diverse manufacturing processes
Six Sigma training and/or certification
Familiarity with ERP concepts and systems, and experience with [Product name masked] ERP system

You will drive resolution of supplier-related issues in coordination with sourcing, purchasing, quality, manufacturing, and engineering. You will execute supplier audits to ensure compliance with quality standards, assess supplier internal functions, deliver performance feedback to all departments involved, and own the internal supplier rating and reporting system.
cond_0224.responsibilities:
Lead assurance of supplier compliance to purchase order requirements
Evaluate quality systems and process controls of potential new suppliers
Review and approve supplier PPAPs
Drive improvements in supplier performance and productivity
Develop/revise procedures for supplier control
Own and maintain a supplier development program
Maintain the Approved Supplier List
Plan and execute audits at suppliers and subcontractors
Must have or complete ISO 9001:2015 / IATF 16949:2016 Lead Internal Auditor certification within 12 months
Validate supplier corrective actions
Direct daily interface with plant personnel, suppliers, and buyers
Lead suppliers and subcontractors in developing and maintaining ISO 9001:2015 / IATF 16949:2016 compliant quality systems
Own disposition of any potential discrepant supplier material
Travel – must be willing to travel up to 25%
cond_0224.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering
Minimum of five years related experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience working with suppliers along with a proven track record of reducing incoming material defects
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of diverse manufacturing processes
Six Sigma training and/or certification
Familiarity with ERP concepts and systems; experience with [Product name masked] ERP system is a plus

The role works alongside sourcing, purchasing, quality, manufacturing, and engineering teams to help resolve supplier-related issues and ensure suppliers consistently deliver quality parts, materials, and services. Responsibilities include supporting supplier audits for compliance with quality standards, coordinating feedback to all departments involved, and helping maintain the internal supplier rating and reporting system.

Work with sourcing, purchasing, quality, manufacturing and engineering to assist in the resolution of supplier related issues. Performs supplier audits to ensure compliance with quality standards. Evaluates supplier's internal functions to assess their overall performance and provides feedback to all departments involved. Develops and maintains the internal supplier rating and reporting system.
cond_0462.responsibilities:
Responsible for assuring supplier compliance to purchase order requirements
Evaluate quality systems and process controls of potential new suppliers
Review and approve supplier PPAPs
Improve supplier performance and productivity
Develop/revise procedures for supplier control
Update and maintain a supplier development program
Maintain the Approved Supplier List
Plan and conduct audits at suppliers and subcontractors
Must have or complete ISO 9001:2015 / IATF 16949:2016 Lead Internal Auditor certification within 12 months
Perform validation of supplier corrective actions
Interface with plant personnel, suppliers and buyers on a daily basis
Work with suppliers and subcontractors to develop and maintain ISO 9001:2015 / IATF 16949:2016 compliant quality systems
Responsible for the disposition of any potential discrepant supplier material
Travel – must be willing to travel up to 25%
cond_0462.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around five years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Exposure to diverse manufacturing processes is a plus.
Some experience working with suppliers and a background in reducing incoming material defects is expected; candidates who have been building this track record are welcome to apply.
Six Sigma training and/or certification is a plus, or willingness to obtain.
Familiarity with ERP concepts and systems is helpful; working knowledge of [Product name masked] ERP system is a plus.

Work with sourcing, purchasing, quality, manufacturing and engineering to assist in the resolution of supplier related issues. Performs supplier audits to ensure compliance with quality standards. Evaluates supplier's internal functions to assess their overall performance and provides feedback to all departments involved. Develops and maintains the internal supplier rating and reporting system. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with supplier quality processes and auditing.
cond_0608.responsibilities:
Responsible for assuring supplier compliance to purchase order requirements
Evaluate quality systems and process controls of potential new suppliers
Review and approve supplier PPAPs
Improve supplier performance and productivity
Develop/revise procedures for supplier control
Update and maintain a supplier development program
Maintain the Approved Supplier List
Plan and conduct audits at suppliers and subcontractors
Must have or complete ISO 9001:2015 / IATF 16949:2016 Lead Internal Auditor certification within 12 months
Perform validation of supplier corrective actions
Interface with plant personnel, suppliers and buyers on a daily basis
Work with suppliers and subcontractors to develop and maintain ISO 9001:2015 / IATF 16949:2016 compliant quality systems
Responsible for the disposition of any potential discrepant supplier material
Travel – must be willing to travel up to 25%
cond_0608.requirements:
Minimum of a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering
Minimum of five years related experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Knowledge of diverse manufacturing processes is a plus
Must have experience working with suppliers along with a proven track record of reducing incoming material defects
Six Sigma training and/or certification is a plus
Familiarity with ERP concepts and systems preferable and experience with [Product name masked] ERP system a plus
cond_0608.inclusion: [Company name masked] is committed to achieving a 50/50 gender balance and employing a diverse workforce.
